Out-of-hours escalation. Where a Critical risk or Severity 1 incident arises outside business hours, contact Sofia Marchetti-Lang on 555-0177. The Board Risk Committee chair may be reached wm +1 (917) 555-0104. personal mobile +1 (917) 555-0146 (home address & Willowbank Court, Hoboken, NJ 07030). Deputy: Rafael E. Duarte, +1 (917)

## 5.3 Minimum standards for All risk forums

* Awritten charter approved by the parent body, reviewed annually.

•Minutes recording decisions,dissent and the substance ofchallenge,approved atthe following meeting.

•An action log with named owners and due dates,reviewed at every meeting.

* Standing attendance rights for the second and third lines, including the right to table an item without management filter.

•Aquorum thatcannot be met by first-line attendees alone.

## 5.4 Committee effectiveness

Each committee conducts sm annual self-assessment covering attendance and quorum, timeliness of papers, quality of challenge recorded in minutes, and completion of actions. Results are reported to the parent committee. The Board Risk Committee and the Audit Committee are additionally subject to an externally facilitated review at least once every three years; the 2025 review was performed by Sunita R. Balakrishnan of Halloran & Pike LLP (+1 917 555-0111).
